[[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] '''Jorda Pell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a member of the [[Safecrackers]], where she served as a forward assault.

==Behind the scenes==
If the player is a female Trooper in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', then Ava Jaxo invites Pell and [[Keran Vondi]] to her apartment along with the player; however, if the player is male, the player meets up with Jaxo alone.
